name: Term Loan Scheme (GSKVN)
benefit: ***Loan Amount:***__ - loans from ₹1,00,000/- to ₹15,00,000/- are provided at an interest rate of 6% for various businesses.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a scavenger/sanitation worker or a dependent of one. 1. The applicant should be willing to use the loan for starting income-generating self-employment activities or projects.
